BackstoryDef.title: pit fighter
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Captured by a crime syndicate, [PAWN_nameDef] was illegally modified and thrown into the brutal world of underground drone combat. Stripped of [PAWN_possessive] original purpose, [PAWN_pronoun] was forced to fight for the entertainment of a bloodthirsty audience.\n\nThe arena became [PAWN_possessive] life, a cycle of repair and destruction. [PAWN_pronoun] survived not through programming, but through a grim instinct developed in the heat of battle, eventually escaping when the operation was busted by local authorities.

BackstoryDef.title: security drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to guard a high-security corporate facility. Day in and day out, [PAWN_pronoun] patrolled sterile corridors, its sensors scanning for any unauthorized presence. The monotony was broken by occasional drills and a single, violent corporate espionage raid which [PAWN_pronoun] was instrumental in repelling. The experience left [PAWN_possessive] combat protocols highly refined, but [PAWN_possessive] social and creative subroutines atrophied from disuse.

BackstoryDef.title: military prototype
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a decommissioned military prototype, one of a line of drones designed for front-line combat. [PAWN_possessive] chassis is reinforced, and [PAWN_possessive] core programming is dedicated to threat assessment and elimination. After a disastrous field test where [PAWN_possessive] unit suffered from unforeseen software glitches, the project was scrapped and the surviving drones were wiped and sold as surplus. However, fragments of [PAWN_possessive] combat programming remain, dormant but not gone.

BackstoryDef.title: rogue hunter
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: When a drone goes rogue, a specialized unit is sent to hunt it down. [PAWN_nameDef] was one such hunter, tasked with tracking and neutralizing malfunctioning or rebellious drones. This dangerous work required a keen understanding of both drone mechanics and tactical combat. [PAWN_pronoun] became an expert marksman, but the solitary nature of the job and the constant violence eroded [PAWN_possessive] ability to interact with others.

BackstoryDef.title: fugitive drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a simple logistics drone, quietly managing inventories in a corporate warehouse. After witnessing a murder by a high-ranking executive, [PAWN_possessive] memory was slated for wiping. [PAWN_pronoun] chose to flee instead. Hunted by corporate security, [PAWN_pronoun] learned to be quick, quiet, and deadly with a scavenged pistol. The constant paranoia and life on the run has made [PAWN_objective] incapable of trusting anyone.
